title: Fin & Feather Inshore Fishing Charters

services.name: Tarpon Fishing
services.desc: Captain Ken Salos, a fifth-generation Floridian, offers inshore fishing charters that bring you closer to our abundant local fisheries and captivating coastal scenery. As a trusted local guide with decades of firsthand experience navigating and fishing Tampa Bay’s inshore waters, his deep-rooted knowledge of the bay area’s tidal movements, seasonal fish patterns, and hidden hotspots allows him to craft each trip to suit your skill level and goals. Whether you’re targeting redfish, snook, speckled trout, or tarpon, Capt. Ken’s deep knowledge, local expertise, and friendly, patient guidance help ensure a productive and unforgettable day on the water. Venturing beyond the more well-traveled

blurb: With years of local expertise and a passion for all things angling, Capt. Ken is dedicated to delivering adventures that cater to novices and seasoned fishermen alike. Whether you’re aiming to land a hard-fighting redfish, glide over pristine flats in search of elusive snook, or simply soak up the breathtaking coastal scenery, you’ll find each trip personalized, exciting, and thoroughly rewarding.
